# VFX UI Anime

> Eighty-two dependency-free Web Component types with eighty-three live gallery demos. Each component is independently loadable and uses the VFX UI Anime spring and impact-motion language.

Live gallery: https://brajesh31.github.io/vfx-ui-anime/
Repository: https://github.com/Brajesh31/vfx-ui-anime

## Project map
- `index.html`: root redirect to the gallery.
- `gallery/index.html`: live demos, interaction examples, install-copy actions, and integration prompts.
- `components/<name>/index.js`: standalone component source with embedded shared runtime.
- `components/<name>/demo.html`: isolated component preview.
- `components/<name>/README.md`: component API, behavior, examples, accessibility, and limits.
- `core.js`: shared motion/effects source of truth.
- `tools/build.mjs`: embeds the latest core in every standalone component.
- `tools/test.mjs`: real touch and keyboard interaction tests in Chromium.
- `registry.json`: component registry metadata.

## Integration rules
1. Load a component file with a plain script tag, not as an ES module.
2. Each component file contains the shared runtime and works independently.
3. Read the component README for its exact attributes, properties, events, keyboard behavior, and form behavior.
4. Honor `prefers-reduced-motion`; effects are decorative and state changes remain immediate.
5. The package is private and has not been published. Do not present a public npm install command yet.

## Branding
- Custom element prefix: `vfx-`.
- Shared runtime global: `window.VFXAnimeFX`.
- CSS custom-property prefix: `--vfx-`.

## Verification
Run `node tools/build.mjs --check`, `npm test`, and `npm run test:browser` before packaging.


## Additional interactive components
- Badge: `components/badge/` `<vfx-badge>`, status markers and pulse.
- Avatar: `components/avatar/` `<vfx-avatar>`, portraits, initials fallback and presence.
- Chip: `components/chip/` `<vfx-chip>`, selectable and removable tokens.
- Breadcrumb: `components/breadcrumb/` `<vfx-breadcrumb>`, semantic navigation trails.
- Stepper: `components/stepper/` `<vfx-stepper>`, bounded quantity control with keyboard and form support.


## Advanced interaction components
- Calendar: `components/calendar/` `<vfx-calendar>`, inline month grid and keyboard date navigation.
- Date Picker: `components/date-picker/` `<vfx-date-picker>`, date selection popover.
- Command Palette: `components/command-palette/` `<vfx-command-palette>`, Ctrl/⌘+K command launcher.
- Context Menu: `components/context-menu/` `<vfx-context-menu>`, pointer-anchored and keyboard-triggered action menu.
- Combobox: `components/combobox/` `<vfx-combobox>`, editable filterable option selection.


## Creative workflow components
- Drag and Drop: `components/drag-drop/` `<vfx-drag-drop>`, native reorder plus touch and keyboard controls.
- Carousel: `components/carousel/` `<vfx-carousel>`, swipe, arrow, dot, and keyboard navigation.
- Timeline: `components/timeline/` `<vfx-timeline>`, selectable milestone sequence.
- Radial Menu: `components/radial-menu/` `<vfx-radial-menu>`, expanding action wheel.
- Image Cropper: `components/image-cropper/` `<vfx-image-cropper>`, browser-local crop and PNG export.


## Workflow and data components
- Kanban Board: `components/kanban/` `<vfx-kanban>`, draggable tasks with accessible lane selectors.
- Data Grid: `components/data-grid/` `<vfx-data-grid>`, local filter, sorting, selection, and paging.
- Tree View: `components/tree-view/` `<vfx-tree-view>`, expandable hierarchy and keyboard navigation.
- Signature Pad: `components/signature-pad/` `<vfx-signature-pad>`, touch/pen/mouse drawing and PNG export.
- Before and After: `components/before-after/` `<vfx-before-after>`, native range-driven image comparison.


## Selection and layout components
- Multi Select: `components/multi-select/` `<vfx-multi-select>`, filterable multi-value selection with chips.
- Time Picker: `components/time-picker/` `<vfx-time-picker>`, time input, minute adjustment, and quick presets.
- Transfer List: `components/transfer-list/` `<vfx-transfer-list>`, dual-list selection and bulk movement.
- Split Pane: `components/split-pane/` `<vfx-split-pane>`, accessible pointer and keyboard resizing.
- Lightbox Gallery: `components/lightbox-gallery/` `<vfx-lightbox-gallery>`, modal image browsing and keyboard navigation.


## Productivity and creative controls
- Password Field: `components/password-field/` `<vfx-password-field>`, accessible reveal state, configurable strength rules, native form validity and reset.
- Date Range Picker: `components/date-range-picker/` `<vfx-date-range-picker>`, required and chronological validation, endpoint bounds and inclusive quick ranges.
- Notification Center: `components/notification-center/` `<vfx-notification-center>`, live inbox data, unread filtering, mark-read, bulk read, dismiss and state events.
- Rich Text Editor: `components/rich-text-editor/` `<vfx-rich-text-editor>`, formatting, lists, undo/redo, keyboard shortcuts, required forms and allowlist-sanitized HTML.
- Gradient Picker: `components/gradient-picker/` `<vfx-gradient-picker>`, two-to-eight editable CSS gradient stops, stop positions, angle, presets and form value.


## Workflow and utility components
- Multi-step Wizard: `components/wizard/` `<vfx-wizard>`, slotted flow steps, validation, progress, and completion.
- Guided Tour: `components/guided-tour/` `<vfx-guided-tour>`, selector-based spotlight guide with keyboard navigation.
- Stopwatch: `components/stopwatch/` `<vfx-stopwatch>`, start/stop, lap timing, and reset.
- Emoji Picker: `components/emoji-picker/` `<vfx-emoji-picker>`, curated searchable emoji collection.
- Copy Code Block: `components/copy-code/` `<vfx-copy-code>`, line numbers, copy action, and clipboard fallback.


## Charts and dashboards
- Bar Chart: components/bar-chart/, <vfx-bar-chart>. Responsive SVG bar chart with interactive bars.
- Donut Chart: components/donut-chart/, <vfx-donut-chart>. Proportional SVG donut chart with legend.
- Sparkline: components/sparkline/, <vfx-sparkline>. Inline SVG trend sparkline.
- KPI Card: components/kpi-card/, <vfx-kpi-card>. Compact dashboard metric tile.
- Gauge: components/gauge/, <vfx-gauge>. Semicircular metric gauge.


## Data visualization and creative tools
- Heatmap: components/heatmap/, <vfx-heatmap>. Seven-column activity intensity grid.
- Treemap: components/treemap/, <vfx-treemap>. Proportional category tile map.
- Drawing Canvas: components/drawing-canvas/, <vfx-drawing-canvas>. Responsive pointer/touch and keyboard drawing with undo, accessible instructions, resize preservation, and PNG export.
- Color Palette: components/color-palette/, <vfx-color-palette>. CSS functional color swatches with roving keyboard focus, selection events, and clipboard fallback.
- Audio Player: components/audio-player/, <vfx-audio-player>. Custom native-media transport with live metadata, normalized seeking, loop, and distinct media lifecycle events.


## Media and editor components
- Video Player: components/video-player/, <vfx-video-player>. Native video transport with accessible seeking, mute, loop, fullscreen state, and distinct metadata/duration events.
- Markdown Editor: components/markdown-editor/, <vfx-markdown-editor>. Split/Write/Preview tabs with DOM-node Markdown rendering and HTTP, HTTPS, and mailto link checks.
- JSON Editor: components/json-editor/, <vfx-json-editor>. Live JSON parsing, formatted text preview, validity state, formatting and minification.
- 3D Tilt Card: components/tilt-card/, <vfx-tilt-card>. Mouse/pen perspective, dynamic text attributes, neutral reset, and reduced-motion handling.
- 3D Flip Card: components/flip-card/, <vfx-flip-card>. Accessible button-driven front/back state with aria-pressed, inactive-face hiding, and reduced-motion support.


## Advanced motion components
- Particle Field: components/particle-field/, <vfx-particle-field>. Responsive canvas field with live count/speed/color properties, pause, resize cleanup, and reduced-motion freeze.
- Marquee: components/marquee/, <vfx-marquee>. Looping slot content with pause-on-hover/focus, inert duplicate content, dynamic slot updates, and reduced-motion support.
- Scroll Reveal: components/scroll-reveal/, <vfx-scroll-reveal>. Configurable Intersection Observer reveal with dynamic slots, once/repeat modes, reveal/conceal events, and reconnect cleanup.
- Animated Counter: components/animated-counter/, <vfx-animated-counter>. Locale/decimal formatting, finite numeric targets, completion announcements, and reduced-motion finalization.
- Confetti Button: components/confetti-button/, <vfx-confetti-button>. Safe label updates, celebrate event, disabled guard, and reduced-motion effect suppression.


## Quality and redesign standards
- `docs/quality/PHASE-1-COMPONENT-AUDIT.md`: baseline inventory, source findings, and component-specific redesign targets for all 82 components.
- `docs/quality/ANIMATION-DESIGN-SYSTEM.md`: shared visual tokens, motion grammar, runtime, accessibility, responsive and performance standards.
- `docs/quality/PHASE-1-ACCEPTANCE-MATRIX.md`: universal and component-family quality gates for subsequent phases.


## Phase 2 signature control upgrades
- `docs/quality/PHASE-2-SIGNATURE-CONTROLS.md`: behavior and quality refinements to the eleven signature controls, including form lifecycle, validation, overlay interactions, reduced motion and browser regression coverage.


## Phase 3 core interface and feedback controls
- `docs/quality/PHASE-3-CORE-CONTROLS.md`: 18 core-control refinements, merge information and verified automated checks. Manual visual and assistive-technology review remains outstanding.
- `docs/quality/PHASE-4-NAVIGATION-OVERLAYS.md`: implementation scope and regression coverage for navigation, overlays and date-selection controls.

## Phase 5 creative-workflow controls
- `docs/quality/PHASE-5-CREATIVE-WORKFLOW.md`: Drag and Drop, Carousel, Timeline, Radial Menu and Image Cropper reliability work, dynamic data synchronization, keyboard/focus behavior, crop export and regression coverage.

## Deployment
- Live hosting: GitHub Pages.
- Workflow: `.github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml`, triggered by pushes to `main` and manual workflow dispatch.
- The workflow validates the source, uploads the repository root and deploys through GitHub Pages.

## Phase 6 workflow, data and creative controls
- `docs/quality/PHASE-6-WORKFLOW-DATA-CREATIVE.md`: Kanban, Data Grid, Tree View, Signature Pad and Before & After upgrades, dynamic state contracts, keyboard operation and regression coverage.


## Phase 7 advanced selection and layout controls
- `docs/quality/PHASE-7-ADVANCED-SELECTION-LAYOUT.md`: Multi Select, Time Picker, Transfer List, Split Pane and Lightbox Gallery upgrades, API contracts, browser regression coverage, CI results and remaining manual sign-off.


## Phase 11 creative tools and media controls
- docs/quality/PHASE-11-CREATIVE-TOOLS-AUDIO.md: Drawing Canvas, Color Palette, and Audio Player reliability, accessibility, data parsing, media lifecycle, and browser regression coverage.

## Phase 12 media, editors, and 3D cards
- docs/quality/PHASE-12-MEDIA-EDITORS-CARDS.md: Video Player, Markdown Editor, JSON Editor, 3D Tilt Card, and 3D Flip Card behavior, accessibility, media lifecycle, safe preview rendering, and browser regression coverage.

## Phase 13 advanced motion and celebration components
- docs/quality/PHASE-13-ADVANCED-MOTION.md: Particle Field, Marquee, Scroll Reveal, Animated Counter, and Confetti Button configuration, lifecycle, accessibility, and browser regression coverage.
